title: A comparison of machine learning algorithms for diabetes prediction
notes: Kim cuong cu (gem) - paper so sanh ML tren PIMA duoc cite nhat trong thoi ky 2021. 7 ML algorithms + NN. Best: NN 2HL 400 epoch lr=0.01 acc 88.6% (test split 85/15, KHONG K-fold). LR/SVM ~77-78% K-fold. Khong xu ly imbalance, khong AUC, khong code public. Tot de cite trong related work.
corrections: dataset/method/code khop voi full text: PIMA (PIDD), 7 ML + 3 NN, code null - khong can sua slug.

Best ML accuracy (train/test split) thuc te la KNN va AdaBoost 79.42% (Bang 6), cao hon LR 78.85%; note cu nhan manh LR/SVM la theo loi van tac giả khen 'works well' nhung khong phai diem accuracy cao nhat.
Xac nhan 88.6% (NN 2 lop an, 400 epoch) chi tu train/test split 85/15; o 10-fold CV NN 2HL chi ~76% (Muc 4.2). Paper KHONG cong bo AUC dang so (chi ROC Fig.11).
